heading: After two rounds of workshops, I streamlined the user flows for the delivery system with teams.

blocks.html: I generated the user flow for the part I was responsible for, then integrated the parts from other designers to form the complete user flow. I presented the complete user flow to the team and iterated it during two workshops, bringing the team onboard with the complete structure that aligned with drivers' needs.
